name: ucsc_gtf
description: GTF annotation as distributed by UCSC, stored verbatim. Named for its actual source so the vault does not claim a provenance it does not have: refgenie ships no UCSC GTF recipe, and filing a UCSC annotation under gencode_gtf would assert a GENCODE origin (GENCODE publishes human and mouse only). Like gencode_gtf this is a passthrough - it does not derive TSS or gene-body BEDs, because those transformations in ensembl_gtf assume Ensembl contig naming and attribute ordering and would corrupt UCSC input.

required_files.description: Annotation file in Gene Transfer Format (GTF) from UCSC
